item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Windows Server 2025 on AKS
item.description:
AKS now supports Windows Server 2025 in general availability, giving customers a newer Windows node option for Windows-based Kubernetes workloads on Azure. This is intended to help with modernization as older Windows Server versions near retirement.

  • Source: Azure Updates
